title: Silent Ransom Group claims “Luna Moth Files” are fake. The data suggest otherwise
content_md: On Tuesday, cybersecurity professionals began investigating an onion site that appeared to contain internal chat files from Silent Ransom Group. On Thursday, Silent Ransom Group said the leak was fake, but is it? A bespoke site called “Luna Moth Files” appeared Tuesday morning.
